How hatching works

Eggs come from two places: wild spawn locations around the islands, or your Breeding Farm. The egg's element and size determine which Pals can hatch from it — bigger eggs tend to hold rarer, stronger Pals.

Put an egg in the Egg Incubator and keep it in the right temperature zone (its "preferred temperature") to hatch it at normal speed. Match the temperature and the timer runs normally; in a mismatched zone, incubation stalls or crawls. Use heaters, coolers or natural biomes (deserts = hot, snowy mountains = cold) to get the right temperature.

Temperature quick guide

🔥 Hot

Dragon, Rocky, Scorching eggs. Find heat in deserts, volcanoes or near heaters.

☀️ Warm

Common, Electric, Verdant eggs. Most starting regions are warm enough.

❄️ Cool

Damp, Dark, Frozen eggs. Snowy mountains, caves or coolers work.
